candidates.name: Infectious Tenosynovitis
support_spans: worsening right hand pain, swelling, and erythema
painful, fluctuant mass extending from the palmar web space to the A2 pulley of the fourth digit
focal tenderness over the flexor sheath and limited active digit motion
WBC count was 17.5 × 10^9/L
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of worsening hand pain, swelling, erythema, and a painful fluctuant mass, along with elevated WBC count, are consistent with infectious tenosynovitis.

candidates.name: Pyogenic Flexor Tenosynovitis
support_spans: painful, fluctuant mass extending from the palmar web space to the A2 pulley of the fourth digit
focal tenderness over the flexor sheath and limited active digit motion
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of a painful, fluctuant mass and focal tenderness over the flexor sheath are consistent with pyogenic flexor tenosynovitis.

candidates.name: Septic Arthritis
support_spans: diffuse soft-tissue swelling throughout the palm and into the distal interphalangeal joints of the third and fourth digits
WBC count was 17.5 × 10^9/L
candidates.why: The patient's elevated WBC count and diffuse soft-tissue swelling into the distal interphalangeal joints suggest septic arthritis.

candidates.name: Cellulitis
support_spans: worsening right hand pain, swelling, and erythema, most prominent in the distal palm
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of worsening pain, swelling, and erythema are consistent with cellulitis.

candidates.name: Pyogenic Flexor Tenosynovitis
support_spans: painful, fluctuant mass extending from the palmar web space to the A2 pulley of the fourth digit
focal tenderness over the flexor sheath
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and examination findings are consistent with pyogenic flexor tenosynovitis, a serious infection of the flexor tendon sheath.

selector.rationale: The presence of a painful, fluctuant mass extending from the palmar web space to the A2 pulley of the fourth digit, along with focal tenderness over the flexor sheath and limited active digit motion, strongly supports Pyogenic Flexor Tenosynovitis as it specifically involves the flexor tendon sheath.

rejected.label: Septic Arthritis
rejected.why: While there is diffuse soft-tissue swelling and an elevated WBC count, the primary findings are more localized to the flexor sheath rather than the joint itself, making Septic Arthritis less likely.

rejected.label: Cellulitis
rejected.why: Cellulitis is a broader condition involving skin and subcutaneous tissue infection, but the specific involvement of the flexor sheath and the presence of a fluctuant mass point towards a more localized infection like Pyogenic Flexor Tenosynovitis.
